description: This PHP source file defines a class 'LoggerSubscriber' that subscribes to Symfony's KernelException events, and logs exception messages and traces using the OrangeHRM framework's logger.

classes.name: LoggerSubscriber
classes.description: A Symfony event subscriber class that listens to kernel exception events and logs exception details.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the KernelEvents::EXCEPTION event to the handler 'onExceptionEvent' with high priority.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the exception event by retrieving the exception and logging its message and trace.
